PATHOLOGY_CASE.definition: This activity table contains a single record for every pathology case included in the PathNet Anatomic Pathology system. It is a key table for most queries (every case has a record included), and the records are maintained indefinately.

columns.name: ACCESSIONED_DT_TM
columns.definition: This field includes the date and time the case was accessioned.

columns.name: ACCESSION_NBR
columns.definition: This field includes the case number assigned to the pathology case.

columns.name: ACCESSION_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: This field contains the internal identification code associated with the user who accessioned the case (the user who caused the row to be added to the PATHOLOGY_CASE table. This value could be used to join to information on the PRSNL and PERSON tables.

columns.name: AUTOPSY_DESCRIPTION
columns.definition: This field is not used at this time.

columns.name: AUTOPSY_SCOPE_CD
columns.definition: This field is not used at this time.

columns.name: BLOB_BITMAP
columns.definition: This column indicates whether or not there is any additional blob data associated with this case row (i.e. case images).

columns.name: CANCEL_CD
columns.definition: If the case is cancelled, this field contains the identification code associated with the cancellation reason.

columns.name: CANCEL_DT_TM
columns.definition: If the case is cancelled, this field contains the date and time the cancellation event occurred.

columns.name: CANCEL_ID
columns.definition: If the case is cancelled, this field contains the internal identification code of the user who executed the cancellation event. This value could be used to join to user information stored on the PRSNL and PERSON tables.

columns.name: CASE_COLLECT_DT_TM
columns.definition: This field includes the collection date and time associated with the case. Note that collection date and time information specific to the specimen(s) submitted for the case is stored on the CASE_SPECIMEN table.

columns.name: CASE_ID
columns.definition: This field uniquely identifies a row included on the PATHOLOGY_CASE table. This field is used to represent a pathology case, and would be used to join to other tables (as a foreign key) such as the CASE_REPORT and CASE_SPECIMEN tables. CASE_ID is derived from ACCESSION.ACCESSION_

columns.name: CASE_NUMBER
columns.definition: This field includes the sequential number portion of the case (accession) number. The entire number is stored in the ACCESSION_NBR field.

columns.name: CASE_RECEIVED_DT_TM
columns.definition: This field includes the received date and time associated with the case. Note that the received date and time information specific to the specimen(s) submitted for the case is stored on the CASE_SPECIMEN table.

columns.name: CASE_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: This field includes the identification code associated with the case type value. The case type is used to generically categorize the case based on the accession prefix value. Examples of case types include surgical, gyn, non-gyn, and autopsy.

columns.name: CASE_YEAR
columns.definition: This field includes the year portion of the case (accession) number. The entire number is stored in the ACCESSION_NBR field.

columns.name: CHR_IND
columns.definition: This indicator value specifies, for a pathology case, whether or not the patient was flagged as being at "clinical high risk (CHR)" for developing cervical cancer. If a value exists in the MAIN_REPORT_COMPLETE_DT_TM field for the case, the CHR flag is classified as a final (histo

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.definition: This field is no longer used. Refer to the COMMENTS_LONG_TEXT_ID for information regarding the pathology case comment.

columns.name: COMMENTS_LONG_TEXT_ID
columns.definition: This field contains the value representing the entry on the LONG_TEXT table that contains the pathology case comment.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD
columns.definition: Contributor system identifies the source feed of data from which a row was populated. This is mainly used to determine how to update a set of data that may have originated from more than one source feed.

columns.name: DATASET_UID
columns.definition: This field contains the dataset UID string that will be assigned for this case. Each DICOM image that is attached to this case will use this dataset UID string.

columns.name: ENCNTR_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: EXT_ACCESSION_NBR
columns.definition: This field contains the 'accession_nbr' from a contributor_system_cd. This field is only field out on a AP history upload.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.definition: This field contains the foreign key value used to join to accession group information. Accession group information is stored in common tables, and AP-specific accession group information is stored on the PREFIX_GROUP table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_SEND_CNT
columns.definition: This field counts the number of times a case is interfaced to a foreign system is sent outbound.

columns.name: LOC_BUILDING_CD
columns.definition: This field contains the internal identification code of the "building" portion of the ordering location value, if specified. This value could be used to join to location-specific information stored on the LOCATION table and associated codesets.

columns.name: LOC_FACILITY_CD
columns.definition: This field contains the internal identification code of the "facility" portion of the ordering location value, if specified. This value could be used to join to location-specific information stored on the LOCATION table and associated codesets.

columns.name: LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: This field contains the internal identification code of the "nursing station" portion of the ordering location value, if specified. This value could be used to join to location-specific information stored on the LOCATION table and associated codesets.

columns.name: MAIN_REPORT_CMPLETE_DT_TM
columns.definition: This field contains the date and time the primary report associated with the case was verified.

columns.name: NEXT_FOREIGN_WS_NBR
columns.definition: Maintains the next available foreign worksheet number for a pathology case.

columns.name: ORIGIN_FLAG
columns.definition: This field contains a flag value documenting how the case was added to the PATHOLOGY_CASE table. Cases can be added by accessioning, cases can be added to history manually, and cases can be added to history via an interface, for example.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the person table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: PREFIX_ID
columns.definition: This field includes the identification code representing the prefix portion of the case (accession) number. The entire number is stored in the ACCESSION_NBR field. Accession prefix information is stored on the AP_PREFIX table.

columns.name: RECEIVED_SMEAR_IND
columns.definition: Indicator value specifies whether the gynecological smears for the case were received from outside the laboratory.

columns.name: REQUESTING_PHYSICIAN_ID
columns.definition: This field includes the internal identification code associated with the physician who is designated as the requesting physician for this case. Other physicians for this case (copy to physicians) are stored on the CASE_PROVIDER table.

columns.name: RESERVED_IND
columns.definition: This field includes an indicator documenting whether or not the case is accession number is in a reserved status.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_PATHOLOGIST_ID
columns.definition: This field includes the internal identification code associated with the pathologist assigned to the case, if present. This value could be used to join to user information stored on the PRSNL and PERSON tables.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_RESIDENT_ID
columns.definition: This field includes the internal identification code associated with the resident assigned to the case, if present. This value could be used to join to user information stored on the PRSNL and PERSON tables.

columns.name: SOURCE_OF_SMEAR_CD
columns.definition: This field contains the identification code associated with the source of the gynecological smears for the case. Examples would be GP, GUM, and NHS Hospital

columns.name: UPDT_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the row was last inserted or updated. The UPDT family of columns are typically used for housekeeping and external system process and should never be depended on for solution specific logic.

columns.name: UPDT_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the row in the table. The UPDT family of columns are typically used for housekeeping and external system process and should never be depended on for solution specific logic.

columns.name: BEG_DT_TM
columns.definition: The beginning date/time of the range of medication admin events.

columns.name: CAREAWARE_USED_IND
columns.definition: Maintains whether CareAware was used to obtain drug related information.

columns.name: CLINICAL_WARNING_CNT
columns.definition: The number of clinical warnings presented for this medication admin event.

columns.name: CRITICAL_DRUG_IND
columns.definition: Indicates that the alert occurred upon a medication that was critically defined.

columns.name: DOCUMENTATION_ACTION_SEQUENCE
columns.definition: The action sequence of the order that the medication admin event is associated to.

columns.name: END_DT_TM
columns.definition: The end date/time of the range of medication admin events.

columns.name: EVENT_CNT
columns.definition: The number of medication admin events in the range of beginning and end date/time.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.definition: The ID of the clinical event associated to this medication admin event.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Identifies what type of event was audited. Values can be code_value for TASKPURGED, TASKCOMPLETE, NOTDONE, or NOTGIVEN from code_set 4000040.

columns.name: MED_ADMIN_EVENT_ID
columns.definition: The ID of the medication administration event.

columns.name: NEEDS_VERIFY_FLAG
columns.definition: Indicator on whether this order is verified. 0 No Verify Needed 1 Verify 40 Needed 2 Superseded 3 Verified 4 Rejected 5 Reviewed

columns.name: NURSE_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: The nurse unit of the device the user is using to enter the medication admin event.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.definition: The ID of the order associated to this med admin event.

columns.name: ORDER_RESULT_VARIANCE_IND
columns.definition: Indicates if the documented result details do not match the order details.

columns.name: POSITION_CD
columns.definition: The position of the user documenting the medication admin event.

columns.name: POSITIVE_MED_IDENT_IND
columns.definition: Indicates if the medication was positively identified for this medication admin event.

columns.name: POSITIVE_PATIENT_IDENT_IND
columns.definition: Indicates if the patient was positively identified for this medication admin event.

columns.name: PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The ID of the user documenting the medication admin event.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the task was scheduled to be given.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_TZ
columns.definition: Time zone associated with the corresponding DT_TM column.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_FLAG
columns.definition: Identification for source application used to chart med event.0

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ORDER_ID
columns.definition: Order id for the template order.

columns.name: UPDT_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the row was last inserted or updated.

columns.name: UPDT_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the row in the table.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time verification of the order took place.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_TZ
columns.definition: Time zone associated with the corresponding DT_TM column.

columns.name: VERIFIED_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The personnel that verified the order.

BILL_ITEM.definition: Contains all items/activities that can be billed for.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: BILL_ITEM_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the bill item .....

columns.name: CALC_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: CARESET_IND
columns.definition: Identifies a bill item as a careset (an orderable is a group of other orderables and/or tasks).

columns.name: CHARGE_POINT_CD
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: CHILD_SEQ
columns.definition: The child sequence is used for caresets only, to allow an orderable to be added into a careset multiple times.

columns.name: COST_BASIS_AMT
columns.definition: This is the cost on which the final charge price is based on (before markups, discounts, tax, etc.)

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: EXT_CHILD_CONTRIBUTOR_CD
columns.definition: Value from 13016 that represents the source of the child bill item. It makes the child reference id unique (in the case of multiple child reference id sources)

columns.name: EXT_CHILD_ENTITY_NAME
columns.definition: Indicates whether the contributor was another bill item as in the case of specific addons as indicated by 'bill_item', or if it was an external contributor as indicated by 'code_value'. Primarily used for data merging.

columns.name: EXT_CHILD_REFERENCE_ID
columns.definition: The id used to cross reference external child information to internal bill items during charging/pricing. For example, this contains the catalog_cd for order catalog items, or the task_assay_cd for discrete task assays, or the task_id for tasks.

columns.name: EXT_DESCRIPTION
columns.definition: The description that will be used to define the bill item.

columns.name: EXT_OWNER_CD
columns.definition: Code that indicates from what entry in codeset 106 this bill item was contributed. 106 entry examples include General Lab, Radiology, etc.

columns.name: EXT_PARENT_CONTRIBUTOR_CD
columns.definition: Code that makes the parent reference id unique (in the case of multiple parent reference id sources)

columns.name: EXT_PARENT_ENTITY_NAME
columns.definition: Indicates whether the contributor for the parent was another bill item as in the case of specific as indicated by 'bill_item', or if it was an external contributor as indicated by 'code_value'. This is blank for default children.

columns.name: EXT_PARENT_REFERENCE_ID
columns.definition: The id used to cross reference external parent information to internal bill items during charging/pricing.

columns.name: EXT_SHORT_DESC
columns.definition: The short description sent from the contributor.

columns.name: EXT_SUB_OWNER_CD
columns.definition: Code that indicates from what entry in codeset 5801 this bill item was contributed. 5801 entry examples include Toxicology, Immunology, etc.

columns.name: LATE_CHRG_EXCL_IND
columns.definition: Allows the user to designate that a bill item should always be excluded from Profit's late charge processing logic.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOMAIN_ENABLED_IND
columns.definition: The indicator for logical domain is enabled or not.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOMAIN_ID
columns.definition: Uniquely identifies the logical domain to which this bill item is related.

columns.name: MISC_IND
columns.definition: This field is used by CSBatchChargeEntry to determine if it needs to prompt for price, description, etc.

columns.name: NUM_HITS
columns.definition: This field is essentially a counter that keeps track of the number of times this particular bill item is hit by the server.

columns.name: PARENT_QUAL_CD
columns.definition: Indicates if the bill item is a parent. Should not have the "cd" extension.

columns.name: PARENT_QUAL_IND
columns.definition: Indicates if the bill item is a parent.

columns.name: PHYSICIAN_QUAL_CD
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: STATS_ONLY_IND
columns.definition: This field indicates that a charge generated for this item will not be interfaced. It is captured for statistical purposes only.

columns.name: TAX_IND
columns.definition: Tax indicator

columns.name: UPDT_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the row was last inserted or updated.

columns.name: UPDT_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the row in the table.

columns.name: WORKLOAD_ONLY_IND
columns.definition: Determines whether this bill item is for workload use only. It is used to filter bill items from the Pricing Tool when not in workload mode.

BILL_ITEM_MODIFIER.definition: Additional information connected to a bill item that may modify pricing of bill items such as addon items, charge points, bill codes. Bill_item_type_cd defines the type of modification.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: BILL_ITEM_ID
columns.definition: ID of the bill item on the bill_item table to which this modification is associated. This is the unique primary identifier of the bill_item table.

columns.name: BILL_ITEM_MOD_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the bill item modifier table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: BILL_ITEM_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Code from 13019 that indicates what type of bill item modifier this row is, such as addon, bill code, or charge point.

columns.name: BIM1_IND
columns.definition: This field holds the indicator for result as quantity for workload.

columns.name: BIM1_INT
columns.definition: This field stores the quantity, priority or binary representation based on the type cd.

columns.name: BIM1_NBR
columns.definition: This field holds the unit override for workload. This will allow the user to override the units default off of the workload_code table and enter a different value.

columns.name: BIM2_INT
columns.definition: This field stores a multiplier based on the type code.

columns.name: BIM_IND
columns.definition: This field stores the projected indicator based on the type cd.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: KEY1
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY10
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY11
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY11_ID
columns.definition: For Workload only, contains an override value for the multiplier, or (-1) if there is no override.

columns.name: KEY12
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY12_ID
columns.definition: For Workload only, contains the code value of the template to be used for interval calculation of Workload units. This is an optional value. Still considering whether this value can be specified here or if it must come from the Workload Standard.

columns.name: KEY13
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY13_ID
columns.definition: Indicates whether this workload row should be considered projected or not. This is used primarily by Work Assignment in pulling projected workload values into the application.

columns.name: KEY14
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY14_ID
columns.definition: The unique identifier to the workload_standard table.

columns.name: KEY15
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY15_ID
columns.definition: Unique identifier to the code_value table for the item for count on the workload. This is usually going to be a (-1) to indicate that the value on the standard is not being overridden.

columns.name: KEY1_ENTITY_NAME
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY1_ID
columns.definition: Depending on the bill_item_type_cd, this is the code value of the charge point or bill code schedule from 14002, or it is the bill_item_id of the addon from the bill_item table.

columns.name: KEY2
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY2_ENTITY_NAME
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY2_ID
columns.definition: Depending on the bill_item_type_cd, this is the priority of bill codes; for charge points it is the code value from 13029 for the actual charge point; and for addons, is the code value from 106 (external owner).

columns.name: KEY3
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY3_ENTITY_NAME
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY3_ID
columns.definition: Depending on the bill_item_type_cd, this is not used for bill codes; it indicates whether the charge point is manual for charge points; and represents the quantity of the addon.

columns.name: KEY4

columns.definition: not used

columns.definition: not used

columns.definition: not used

columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY5_ID
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: KEY6
columns.definition: Depending on the bill_item_type_cd, this is the bill code; not used for charge points; is the description of the addon.

columns.name: KEY7
columns.definition: Depending on the bill_item_type_cd, it is the description of the bill code; not used for charge points; not used for addons.

columns.name: KEY8

columns.definition: A code value that uniquely identifies to which "net" (PathNet, RadNet) and/or what department (General Lab, Microbiology) an order belongs.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time associated with an adjustment.

columns.name: ADMIT_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: This is the value from codeset 71 that represents the visit/encounter type from this encounter, if available.

columns.name: ALPHA_NOMEN_ID
columns.definition: alpha_nomen_id, which will hold the alpha nomen id for alpha response charges, will help the charging server when creating offsets so it will match up a debit with a credit correctly if the offset already exists.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM

columns.name: BUNDLE_ID

columns.name: CHARGE_DESCRIPTION

columns.name: CHARGE_EVENT_ACT_ID

columns.name: CHARGE_ITEM_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the charge table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Value from 13028 that represents whether the charge event is a debit, credit, collection, no charge, etc.

columns.name: COMBINE_IND
columns.definition: Indicates if this charge has been combined "away". This is set on the "from" charges in the combine scripts so that the batch process that runs in operations to find the "stragglers" knows which charges on an encounter or person have already been processed.

columns.name: COST_CENTER_CD
columns.definition: This field is the cost center that a charge is associated with.

columns.name: CREDITED_DT_TM

columns.name: CS_CPP_UNDO_ID
columns.definition: Uniquely identifies a specific undo record related to this charge record.

columns.definition: If this charge was written as a result of qualifying in an interval for which multiple charges are created, this is the unique identifier of the item interval on which the charge was created.

columns.name: ITEM_PRICE
columns.definition: The price as determined through tier logic, after discounting has been applied.

columns.definition: Indicates the offset that the item price was adjusted by using the Price Adjustment Factor

columns.name: ITEM_QUANTITY
columns.definition: The quantity the price should be multiplied by to arrive at the item_extended_price.

columns.definition: Indicates the portion of Item_Extended_Price that is the patient's Health Plan's responsibility. columns.definition: This is the value from codeset 221 that represents the level 5 (exam room, bench, instrument) in the service resource hierarchy.

columns.name: LIST_PRICE_SCHED_ID
columns.definition: The price schedule identifier associated with the list price schedule identified in the tier.

columns.name: MANUAL_IND
columns.definition: Indicates if this charge is currently on hold as a manual charge or if it has ever been on hold as a manual charge.

columns.name: MED_SERVICE_CD

Used primarily as a billing function to trigger a change in charging rates.

columns.definition: The date and time the alternate level of care was assigned

columns.name: ARRIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The actual date/time that the patient arrived at the facility. At the time of registration, if this field is null then it should be valued with the reg_dt_tm. Otherwise, the actual arrival date/time is captured.

columns.name: ARRIVE_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the arrive_dt_tm.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: CHANGE_BIT

columns.name: CHART_COMMENT_IND
columns.definition: FUTURE USE.

columns.name: COMMENT_TEXT

columns.name: DEPART_DT_TM

columns.name: DEPART_PRSNL_ID

columns.name: ENCNTR_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter location history table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: ENCNTR_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Categorizes the encounter into a logical group or type. Examples may include inpatient, outpatient, etc. For this table, it is the encounter type at the time the history row is written.

columns.name: ENCNTR_TYPE_CLASS_CD
columns.definition: Encounter type class is used to categorize patients into more general groups than encounter type. (i.e., inpatient, outpatient, emergency, recurring outpatient). The values in this code set all have Cerner defined meanings.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: ISOLATION_CD
columns.definition: The isolation code indicates that some level of isolation or restricted access is required or in place for this patient indicating special procedure or consideration to be used when dealing with the patient.

columns.name: LOCATION_CD
columns.definition: The field identifies the location of the patient/encounter at the time the history row is written. The location will be valued with the lowest available level location type in the hierarchy of facility, building, nurse unit, room, bed.

columns.name: LOCATION_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: FUTURE USE

columns.name: LOCATION_TEMP_IND
columns.definition: NOT USED. Set to TRUE if the location value in the location_cd field is a location with a location type of temporary.

columns.name: LOC_BED_CD
columns.definition: This field is the patient location with a location type of bed at the time the history row is written.

columns.name: LOC_BUILDING_CD
columns.definition: This field is the patient location with a location type of building at the time the history row is written.

columns.name: LOC_FACILITY_CD
columns.definition: This field is the patient location with a location type of facility at the time the history row is written.

columns.name: LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: This field is the patient location with a location type of nurse unit at the time the history row is written.

columns.name: LOC_ROOM_CD
columns.definition: This field is the patient location with a location type of room at the time the history row is written.

columns.name: MED_SERVICE_CD

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID

columns.name: PLACEMENT_AUTH_PRSNL_ID

columns.name: PM_HIST_TRACKING_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the pm_hist_tracking table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: PROGRAM_SERVICE_CD
columns.definition: The program service associated with the location of the patient

columns.name: SECURITY_ACCESS_CD
columns.definition: Security Access Code value.

columns.name: SERVICE_CATEGORY_CD
columns.definition: Codified field which identifies the current category of service the patient is receiving for this encounter.

columns.name: SPECIALTY_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: The specialty associated with a program service

columns.name: TRACKING_BIT

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DT_TM
columns.definition: Date and time the transaction, which triggered the history row, occurred. This field can be system assigned or manually manipulated by users.

columns.name: TRANSFER_REASON_CD
columns.definition: Identifies the reason the person was transferred or moved from one location to another.

columns.name: UPDT_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the row was last inserted or updated. The UPDT family of columns are typically used for housekeeping and external system process and should never be depended on for solution specific logic.

columns.name: UPDT_ID

columns.definition: The data and time at which the health plan benefits were last verified.

columns.definition: The card issue number is used to track the number of cards dispensed. The original card is typically issue number 00, with subsequent cards incremented.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_PRSNL_ID

columns.name: ALT_RESULT_DEST_CD

columns.name: AMBULATORY_COND_CD

columns.name: CHART_ACCESS_ORGANIZATION_ID

columns.name: CHART_COMPLETE_DT_TM

columns.name: CLIENT_REFERENCE_NBR_TXT

columns.name: COMPLETE_REG_DT_TM

columns.name: COMPLETE_REG_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The internal person id of the personnel that completed the collection of all required financial and clinical data necessary for registration. if the complete_reg_dt_tm is valued, then this field should be valued.

columns.name: CONFID_LEVEL_CD
columns.definition: Confidential level identifies a level of security that may restrict access or release of information.

columns.name: CONTRACT_STATUS_CD

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD

columns.definition: This field indicates whether the patient will be extended certain special courtesies such as express discharge, bypassing a stop at the cashiers window upon leaving when financial arrangements are agreed upon in advance.

columns.name: CREATE_DT_TM

columns.name: CREATE_PRSNL_ID

columns.name: DIET_TYPE_CD

columns.name: DISCH_DISPOSITION_CD
columns.definition: The conditions under which the patient left the facility at the time of discharge.

columns.name: DISCH_DT_TM
columns.definition: The actual date/time that the patient was discharged from the facility. columns.name: DOC_RCVD_DT_TM

columns.name: ED_REFERRAL_SOURCE_CD

columns.name: ENCNTR_CLASS_CD
columns.definition: Encounter class defines how this encounter row is being used in relation to the person table.

columns.name: ENCNTR_COMPLETE_DT_TM
columns.definition: Date/time when the encounter is considered to be in a completed status.

columns.name: ENCNTR_FINANCIAL_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter financial table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: ENCNTR_ID
columns.definition: Unique identifier for the Encounter table.

columns.name: ENCNTR_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Encounter status identifies the state of a particular encounter type from the time it is initiated until it is complete. (i.e., temporary, preliminary, active, discharged (complete), cancelled).

columns.name: ENCNTR_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Categorizes the encounter into a logical group or type. Examples may include inpatient, outpatient, etc.

columns.name: ENCNTR_TYPE_CLASS_CD
columns.definition: Encounter type class is used to categorize patients into more general groups than encounter type. (i.e., inpatient, outpatient, emergency, recurring outpatient). The values in this codeset all have Cerner defined meanings.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: EST_ARRIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The estimated or expected date/time that the patient will arrive at the facility. This field may be null.

columns.name: EST_DEPART_DT_TM
columns.definition: The estimated or expected date/time that the patient will depart (outpatient) or will be discharged (inpatient) from the facility. This field may be null.

columns.name: EST_FINANCIAL_RESP_AMT
columns.definition: Contains the estimated amount for which the patient is responsible for this encounter.

columns.name: EST_LENGTH_OF_STAY
columns.definition: Estimated length of the patient/encounter stay, in days

columns.name: EXPECTED_DELIVERY_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the delivery is expected.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_IND
columns.definition: Set to true (1), if the encounter is external to the hospital network. Otherwise, set to false (0).

columns.name: FINANCIAL_CLASS_CD
columns.definition: The financial classification used for a given encounter. Examples may include Worker's Comp, Self Pay, etc.

columns.name: GUARANTOR_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: The guarantor type indicates that the guarantor for the encounter is either a person or an organization. This code is used to determine which set of tables to query to find the guarantor.

columns.name: INCIDENT_CD

columns.name: INFO_GIVEN_BY
columns.definition: Free-text attribute specifying who gave the information for this encounter. Might be a guardian, parent, patient, etc.

columns.name: INITIAL_CONTACT_DT_TM
columns.definition: The initial contact of the patient and the provider submitting the claim.

columns.name: INPATIENT_ADMIT_DT_TM
columns.definition: Stores the inpatient admit date and time

columns.name: ISOLATION_CD
columns.definition: The isolation code indicates that some level of isolation or restricted access is required or in place for this patient indicating special procedure or consideration to be used when dealing with the patient.

columns.name: KIOSK_QUEUE_NBR_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time when the system generated ticket number representing their position within the queue was assigned to the patient when they are checking in for the visit.

columns.name: KIOSK_QUEUE_NBR_TXT
columns.definition: The system generated ticket number assigned to the patient to represent their position within the queue when they are checking in for the visit.

columns.name: LAST_MENSTRUAL_PERIOD_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time of the last menstrual period.

columns.name: LEVEL_OF_SERVICE_CD
columns.definition: The level of service provided. Examples are emergency, elective, urgent and routine.

columns.name: LOCATION_CD
columns.definition: The field identifies the current permanent location of the patient. The location for an inpatient will be valued with the lowest level location type in the hierarchy of facility, building, nurse unit, room, bed.

columns.name: LOC_BED_CD
columns.definition: This field is the current patient location with a location type of bed.

columns.name: LOC_BUILDING_CD
columns.definition: This field is the current patient location with a location type of building.

columns.name: LOC_FACILITY_CD
columns.definition: This field is the current patient location with a location type of facility.

columns.name: LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: This field is the current patient location with a location type of nurse unit.

columns.name: LOC_ROOM_CD
columns.definition: This field is the current patient location with a location type of room.

columns.name: LOC_TEMP_CD
columns.definition: This field identifies the temporary location of the patient. The temporary location may be valued at the same time the location_cd is valued.

columns.name: LODGER_CD
columns.definition: Indicates if an additional person is staying with the patient in the same room.

columns.name: MED_SERVICE_CD
columns.definition: The type or category of medical service that the patient is receiving in relation to their encounter. The category may be of treatment type, surgery, general resources, or others.

columns.name: MENTAL_CATEGORY_CD
columns.definition: Mental category code (ex. Mental illness, Mental impairment, severe mental impairment)

columns.name: MENTAL_HEALTH_CD
columns.definition: The field is the mental health status of a patient which indicates if a patient was involuntarily or voluntarily admitted. This field is not used by all clients.

columns.name: MENTAL_HEALTH_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time of the last time the mental health info was updated.

columns.name: MILITARY_SERVICE_RELATED_CD
columns.definition: Indicates if the patient's visit is related to their military service.

columns.name: NAME_FIRST_SYNONYM_ID
columns.definition: OBSOLETE - This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the first name synonym table. It is an internal system assigned number. columns.name: NAME_LAST_KEY

columns.name: NAME_PHONETIC
columns.definition: OBSOLETE - This is the Soundex coded representation of the person's name. This field is used for indexing and searching for a patient by name when the exact spelling is not known. OBSOLETE: SHOULD USE INFORMATION ON THE PERSON TABLE.

columns.name: ONSET_DT_TM

columns.name: ORDER_SOURCE_CD

columns.name: PATIENT_CLASSIFICATION_CD

columns.name: PAYMENT_COLLECTION_STATUS_CD

columns.name: PERSON_ID

columns.name: PREGNANCY_STATUS_CD
